purpose: Determine whether completed native P3 account/path/decision-chain objects contain the inputs needed for a path-correct training-period risk-projection protection versus SOXX opportunity-cost counterfactual.

Record structural keys, row counts, time spans, fee/holdings/dividend/risk/recovery fields; no new predictions or book replay.
